description: This file defines a custom hook 'usePermissions' for managing user permissions within a specific scope, including functions to check, toggle, and retrieve permission levels, utilizing external permission registry utilities.

methods.name: usePermissions
methods.description: Main hook function that provides permission management utilities based on a given scope.

methods.name: getAllPossiblePermissions
methods.description: Generates a list of all permissions available within the current scope.

methods.name: hasAllPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the provided permissions array includes all permissions for the current scope.

methods.name: getResourcePermissionLevel
methods.description: Determines the permission level ('none', 'read', 'all') for a specific resource based on current permissions.

methods.name: toggleResourcePermissionLevel
methods.description: Toggles the permission level for a resource, updating the permissions list accordingly.

methods.name: toggleSinglePermission
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific permission, updating the permissions list with transitive dependencies or dependents.
